headline: Autoscaling group configuration will not achieve desired scaling — desired_capacity cannot be less than min_size
suppressed: Checkov flagged many pre-existing configuration issues (missing VPC flow logs, S3 versioning, encryption, WAF, RDS logging, etc.). These are not introduced by this change and fall outside the scope of this PR review. The DB instance appears unchanged (the plan shows no effective changes to it).

findings.evidence_ref: In compute.tf, the ASG has min_size=3, max_size=6, and will be updated to desired_capacity=1. AWS enforces that desired_capacity ≥ min_size, so the group will automatically scale back to 3 instances, preventing the cost optimization.
findings.explanation: Setting desired_capacity to 1 while min_size remains at 3 creates an invalid configuration. AWS will ignore the desired_capacity setting and maintain 3 instances to satisfy the minimum. This change will not reduce overnight costs as intended and will fail to achieve the stated goal of the PR. Either reduce min_size to 1 (trading redundancy for cost) or use a scheduled action to temporarily lower both min_size and desired_capacity during off-peak hours.
